prompt: What are the statutory criminal penalties for a first-offense adult DWI conviction in Texas?

options.text: Class C traffic fine of fifty dollars with zero mandatory jail confinement terms
State jail felony carrying five years mandatory confinement in Texas state prison
Class B misdemeanor, fine up to $2,000, 72 hours to 180 days jail, license suspension
A verbal reprimand and attendance at a one-hour online traffic safety seminar
